+bool checkedGridSize(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                     size_t& elementCount, size_t& byteCount) {
+    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    if (plane > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
+        return false;
     }
+    elementCount = plane * nz;
+    if (elementCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(Real)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    byteCount = elementCount * sizeof(Real);
+    return true;
 }

+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;
+    sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 1] = input[index];
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kSweepX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 2] = input[index + 1];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[0][tx + 1] = input[index - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kSweepY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 2][tx + 1] = input[index + nx];
+    }
+}
+
+// Sweep a short Z segment while retaining the vertical neighbors in registers.
+// The current XY plane is staged in shared memory, so each grid value is fetched
+// once per tile rather than separately by all of its X/Y neighbors.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kSweepX * kSweepY, 4)
+void stencilSweep(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ Real planes[2][kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2];
+
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kSweepX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kSweepY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned firstZ = blockIdx.z * kSweepChunk + 1;
+    const unsigned remaining = nz - 1 - firstZ;
+    const unsigned steps = remaining < kSweepChunk ? remaining : kSweepChunk;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(firstZ) * planeStride
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+
+    Real bottom = 0.0;
+    Real center = 0.0;
+    Real top = 0.0;
+    if (active) {
+        bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+        center = input[index];
+        top = input[index + planeStride];
+    }
+    stageSweepPlane(planes[0], input, index, x, y, nx, ny, active);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned currentPlane = 0;
+    for (unsigned step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        const unsigned nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1U;
+        if (step + 1 < steps) {
+            stageSweepPlane(planes[nextPlane], input, index + planeStride,
+                            x, y, nx, ny, active);
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x + 1;
+            const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y + 1;
+            output[index] = (center + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx - 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty - 1][tx]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx]
+                           + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        index += planeStride;
+        bottom = center;
+        center = top;
+        if (active && step + 1 < steps) {
+            top = input[index + planeStride];
         }
+        currentPlane = nextPlane;
+    }
+}

+bool checkedGridSize(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                     size_t& elementCount, size_t& byteCount) {

+        return false;
+    }
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    if (plane > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
+        return false;
     }
+    elementCount = plane * nz;
+    if (elementCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(Real)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    byteCount = elementCount * sizeof(Real);
+    return true;
 }

+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ;

+        grid1[index] = value;

+// The boundaries never change, so both device buffers are initialized with the
+// same values and this kernel only needs to write the interior. Consecutive
+// threads span X, giving every neighbor load a coalesced access pattern.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 2)
+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;

+        return;
     }
-

-    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {

-                    output[idx] = input[idx];
-                }

+
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+    output[index] = (input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                   + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                   + input[index - planeStride] + input[index + planeStride]) / 7.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;
+    sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 1] = input[index];
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kSweepX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 2] = input[index + 1];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[0][tx + 1] = input[index - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kSweepY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 2][tx + 1] = input[index + nx];
+    }
+}
+
+// Sweep a short Z segment while retaining the vertical neighbors in registers.
+// The current XY plane is staged in shared memory, so each grid value is fetched
+// once per tile rather than separately by all of its X/Y neighbors.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kSweepX * kSweepY, 4)
+void stencilSweep(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ Real planes[2][kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2];
+
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kSweepX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kSweepY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned firstZ = blockIdx.z * kSweepChunk + 1;
+    const unsigned remaining = nz - 1 - firstZ;
+    const unsigned steps = remaining < kSweepChunk ? remaining : kSweepChunk;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(firstZ) * planeStride
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+
+    Real bottom = 0.0;
+    Real center = 0.0;
+    Real top = 0.0;
+    if (active) {
+        bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+        center = input[index];
+        top = input[index + planeStride];
+    }
+    stageSweepPlane(planes[0], input, index, x, y, nx, ny, active);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned currentPlane = 0;
+    for (unsigned step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        const unsigned nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1U;
+        if (step + 1 < steps) {
+            stageSweepPlane(planes[nextPlane], input, index + planeStride,
+                            x, y, nx, ny, active);
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x + 1;
+            const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y + 1;
+            output[index] = (center + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx - 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty - 1][tx]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx]
+                           + bottom + top) / 7.0;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        index += planeStride;
+        bottom = center;
+        center = top;
+        if (active && step + 1 < steps) {
+            top = input[index + planeStride];
         }
+        currentPlane = nextPlane;
+    }
+}
+
+bool checkedGridSize(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                     size_t& elementCount, size_t& byteCount) {
+    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    if (plane > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
+        return false;
     }
+    elementCount = plane * nz;
+    if (elementCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(Real)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    byteCount = elementCount * sizeof(Real);
+    return true;
 }

+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_USE_SWEEP
+#define STENCIL_USE_SWEEP 0
+#endif
+constexpr unsigned kSweepX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kSweepY = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kSweepChunk = STENCIL_SWEEP_CHUNK;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_CORRECTED_DIVIDE
+#define STENCIL_CORRECTED_DIVIDE 0
+#endif
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Real averageOfSeven(const Real sum) {
+    if constexpr (STENCIL_CORRECTED_DIVIDE) {
+        constexpr Real reciprocal = 0x1.2492492492492p-3;
+        const Real estimate = sum * reciprocal;
+        const Real remainder = __fma_rn(-7.0, estimate, sum);
+        return __fma_rn(remainder, reciprocal, estimate);
+    } else {
+        return sum / 7.0;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* __restrict__ grid1,
+                                Real* __restrict__ grid2,
+                                const size_t elementCount) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (index < elementCount) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        grid1[index] = value;
+        grid2[index] = value;
+    }
 }
 
-void initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {

+// The boundaries never change, so both device buffers are initialized with the
+// same values and this kernel only needs to write the interior. Consecutive
+// threads span X, giving every neighbor load a coalesced access pattern.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 2)
+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+    const Real sum = input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                   + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                   + input[index - planeStride] + input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;
+    sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 1] = input[index];
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kSweepX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 2] = input[index + 1];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[0][tx + 1] = input[index - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kSweepY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 2][tx + 1] = input[index + nx];
     }
 }

+// Sweep a short Z segment while retaining the vertical neighbors in registers.
+// The current XY plane is staged in shared memory, so each grid value is fetched
+// once per tile rather than separately by all of its X/Y neighbors.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kSweepX * kSweepY, 4)
+void stencilSweep(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ Real planes[2][kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2];
+
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kSweepX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kSweepY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned firstZ = blockIdx.z * kSweepChunk + 1;
+    const unsigned remaining = nz - 1 - firstZ;
+    const unsigned steps = remaining < kSweepChunk ? remaining : kSweepChunk;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(firstZ) * planeStride
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+
+    Real bottom = 0.0;
+    Real center = 0.0;
+    Real top = 0.0;
+    if (active) {
+        bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+        center = input[index];
+        top = input[index + planeStride];
+    }
+    stageSweepPlane(planes[0], input, index, x, y, nx, ny, active);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned currentPlane = 0;
+    for (unsigned step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        const unsigned nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1U;
+        if (step + 1 < steps) {
+            stageSweepPlane(planes[nextPlane], input, index + planeStride,
+                            x, y, nx, ny, active);
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x + 1;
+            const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y + 1;
+            const Real sum = center + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx - 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty - 1][tx]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx]
+                           + bottom + top;
+            output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
         }
-    }
-    
-    // Copy boundary values
-    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
-        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
-            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
-                if (x == 0 || x == nx-1 || y == 0 || y == ny-1 || z == 0 || z == nz-1) {
-                    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
-                    output[idx] = input[idx];
-                }
-            }
+        __syncthreads();
+

+        bottom = center;
+        center = top;
+        if (active && step + 1 < steps) {
+            top = input[index + planeStride];
         }
+        currentPlane = nextPlane;
     }
 }

+constexpr unsigned kBlockX = STENCIL_BLOCK_X;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockY = STENCIL_BLOCK_Y;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockZ = STENCIL_BLOCK_Z;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_SWEEP_CHUNK
+#define STENCIL_SWEEP_CHUNK 16
+#endif
+#ifndef STENCIL_USE_SWEEP
+#define STENCIL_USE_SWEEP 0
+#endif
+constexpr unsigned kSweepX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kSweepY = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kSweepChunk = STENCIL_SWEEP_CHUNK;
+
+#ifndef STENCIL_CORRECTED_DIVIDE
+#define STENCIL_CORRECTED_DIVIDE 0
+#endif
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Real averageOfSeven(const Real sum) {
+    if constexpr (STENCIL_CORRECTED_DIVIDE) {
+        constexpr Real reciprocal = 0x1.2492492492492p-3;
+        const Real estimate = sum * reciprocal;
+        const Real remainder = __fma_rn(-7.0, estimate, sum);
+        return __fma_rn(remainder, reciprocal, estimate);
+    } else {
+        return sum / 7.0;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* __restrict__ grid1,
+                                Real* __restrict__ grid2,
+                                const size_t elementCount) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (index < elementCount) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        grid1[index] = value;
+        grid2[index] = value;
+    }
 }
 
-void initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {

+// The boundaries never change, so both device buffers are initialized with the
+// same values and this kernel only needs to write the interior. Consecutive
+// threads span X, giving every neighbor load a coalesced access pattern.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 2)
+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+    const Real sum = input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                   + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                   + input[index - planeStride] + input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;
+    sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 1] = input[index];
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kSweepX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 2] = input[index + 1];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[0][tx + 1] = input[index - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kSweepY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 2][tx + 1] = input[index + nx];
     }
 }

+// Sweep a short Z segment while retaining the vertical neighbors in registers.
+// The current XY plane is staged in shared memory, so each grid value is fetched
+// once per tile rather than separately by all of its X/Y neighbors.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kSweepX * kSweepY, 4)
+void stencilSweep(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ Real planes[2][kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2];
+
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kSweepX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kSweepY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned firstZ = blockIdx.z * kSweepChunk + 1;
+    const unsigned remaining = nz - 1 - firstZ;
+    const unsigned steps = remaining < kSweepChunk ? remaining : kSweepChunk;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(firstZ) * planeStride
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+

+    Real center = 0.0;
+    Real top = 0.0;
+    if (active) {
+        bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+        center = input[index];
+        top = input[index + planeStride];
+    }
+    stageSweepPlane(planes[0], input, index, x, y, nx, ny, active);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned currentPlane = 0;
+    for (unsigned step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        const unsigned nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1U;
+        if (step + 1 < steps) {
+            stageSweepPlane(planes[nextPlane], input, index + planeStride,
+                            x, y, nx, ny, active);

+

+            const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y + 1;
+            const Real sum = center + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx - 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty - 1][tx]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx]
+                           + bottom + top;

         }

+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;

+    }

+    const Real sum = input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;
+    sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 1] = input[index];
+    if (tx == 0) {

+    }

+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {

+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;

+    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;

+    const Real sum = input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+

+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;

+    }

+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(

codex
A second optimization is both faster and still bit-exact: constant division by seven can use a reciprocal estimate plus an FMA residual correction, yielding the same correctly rounded doubles without CUDA’s costly general division sequence. That raises sustained throughput from roughly 20 to 29 billion updates/s on large grids. I’m doing one last kernel experiment that reuses Z-neighbors in registers across several adjacent cells, which may remove two load instructions per update without changing arithmetic order.

+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+// Each thread advances through a short run in Z. The previous center and top
+// values become the next bottom and center, eliminating two load instructions
+// per update while retaining enough independent blocks to fill the GPU.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 6)
+void stencilZLoop(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {

+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;
+    sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 1] = input[index];
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kSweepX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 2] = input[index + 1];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[0][tx + 1] = input[index - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kSweepY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 2][tx + 1] = input[index + nx];
+    }
+}
+
+// Sweep a short Z segment while retaining the vertical neighbors in registers.
+// The current XY plane is staged in shared memory, so each grid value is fetched
+// once per tile rather than separately by all of its X/Y neighbors.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kSweepX * kSweepY, 4)
+void stencilSweep(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ Real planes[2][kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2];
+
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kSweepX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kSweepY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned firstZ = blockIdx.z * kSweepChunk + 1;
+    const unsigned remaining = nz - 1 - firstZ;
+    const unsigned steps = remaining < kSweepChunk ? remaining : kSweepChunk;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(firstZ) * planeStride
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+
+    Real bottom = 0.0;
+    Real center = 0.0;
+    Real top = 0.0;
+    if (active) {
+        bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+        center = input[index];
+        top = input[index + planeStride];
+    }
+    stageSweepPlane(planes[0], input, index, x, y, nx, ny, active);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned currentPlane = 0;
+    for (unsigned step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        const unsigned nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1U;
+        if (step + 1 < steps) {
+            stageSweepPlane(planes[nextPlane], input, index + planeStride,
+                            x, y, nx, ny, active);
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x + 1;
+            const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y + 1;
+            const Real sum = center + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx - 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty - 1][tx]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx]
+                           + bottom + top;
+            output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        index += planeStride;
+        bottom = center;
+        center = top;
+        if (active && step + 1 < steps) {
+            top = input[index + planeStride];
         }
+        currentPlane = nextPlane;
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 2)
+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;

+// Each thread advances through a short run in Z. The previous center and top
+// values become the next bottom and center, eliminating two load instructions
+// per update while retaining enough independent blocks to fill the GPU.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 6)
+void stencilZLoop(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;
+    sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 1] = input[index];
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kSweepX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 2] = input[index + 1];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[0][tx + 1] = input[index - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kSweepY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 2][tx + 1] = input[index + nx];
+    }
+}
+
+// Sweep a short Z segment while retaining the vertical neighbors in registers.
+// The current XY plane is staged in shared memory, so each grid value is fetched
+// once per tile rather than separately by all of its X/Y neighbors.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kSweepX * kSweepY, 4)
+void stencilSweep(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ Real planes[2][kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2];
+
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kSweepX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kSweepY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned firstZ = blockIdx.z * kSweepChunk + 1;
+    const unsigned remaining = nz - 1 - firstZ;
+    const unsigned steps = remaining < kSweepChunk ? remaining : kSweepChunk;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(firstZ) * planeStride
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+
+    Real bottom = 0.0;
+    Real center = 0.0;
+    Real top = 0.0;
+    if (active) {
+        bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+        center = input[index];
+        top = input[index + planeStride];
+    }
+    stageSweepPlane(planes[0], input, index, x, y, nx, ny, active);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned currentPlane = 0;
+    for (unsigned step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        const unsigned nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1U;
+        if (step + 1 < steps) {
+            stageSweepPlane(planes[nextPlane], input, index + planeStride,
+                            x, y, nx, ny, active);
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x + 1;
+            const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y + 1;
+            const Real sum = center + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx - 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty - 1][tx]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx]
+                           + bottom + top;
+            output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        index += planeStride;
+        bottom = center;
+        center = top;
+        if (active && step + 1 < steps) {
+            top = input[index + planeStride];
         }
+        currentPlane = nextPlane;
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 2)
+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;

+                   + input[index - planeStride] + input[index + planeStride];

+// Each thread advances through a short run in Z. The previous center and top
+// values become the next bottom and center, eliminating two load instructions
+// per update while retaining enough independent blocks to fill the GPU.

+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + bottom + top;

-            }

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;
+    sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 1] = input[index];
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kSweepX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 2] = input[index + 1];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[0][tx + 1] = input[index - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kSweepY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 2][tx + 1] = input[index + nx];
+    }
+}
+
+// Sweep a short Z segment while retaining the vertical neighbors in registers.
+// The current XY plane is staged in shared memory, so each grid value is fetched
+// once per tile rather than separately by all of its X/Y neighbors.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kSweepX * kSweepY, 4)
+void stencilSweep(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ Real planes[2][kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2];
+
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kSweepX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kSweepY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned firstZ = blockIdx.z * kSweepChunk + 1;
+    const unsigned remaining = nz - 1 - firstZ;
+    const unsigned steps = remaining < kSweepChunk ? remaining : kSweepChunk;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(firstZ) * planeStride
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+
+    Real bottom = 0.0;
+    Real center = 0.0;
+    Real top = 0.0;
+    if (active) {
+        bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+        center = input[index];
+        top = input[index + planeStride];
+    }
+    stageSweepPlane(planes[0], input, index, x, y, nx, ny, active);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned currentPlane = 0;
+    for (unsigned step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        const unsigned nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1U;
+        if (step + 1 < steps) {
+            stageSweepPlane(planes[nextPlane], input, index + planeStride,
+                            x, y, nx, ny, active);
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x + 1;
+            const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y + 1;
+            const Real sum = center + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx - 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty - 1][tx]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx]
+                           + bottom + top;
+            output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        index += planeStride;
+        bottom = center;
+        center = top;
+        if (active && step + 1 < steps) {
+            top = input[index + planeStride];
         }
+        currentPlane = nextPlane;
     }
 }

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* __restrict__ grid1,
+                                Real* __restrict__ grid2,
+                                const size_t elementCount) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (index < elementCount) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        grid1[index] = value;
+        grid2[index] = value;
+    }
+}
+
+// The boundaries never change, so both device buffers are initialized with the
+// same values and this kernel only needs to write the interior. Consecutive
+// threads span X, giving every neighbor load a coalesced access pattern.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 2)
+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride
+                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+    const Real sum = input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                   + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                   + input[index - planeStride] + input[index + planeStride];
+    output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
+}
+
+// Each thread advances through a short run in Z. The previous center and top
+// values become the next bottom and center, eliminating two load instructions
+// per update while retaining enough independent blocks to fill the GPU.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY, 6)
+void stencilZLoop(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned firstZ = blockIdx.z * kZLoopChunk + 1;
+    const unsigned remaining = nz - 1 - firstZ;
+    const unsigned steps = remaining < kZLoopChunk ? remaining : kZLoopChunk;
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(firstZ) * planeStride
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+    Real bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+    Real center = input[index];
+    Real top = input[index + planeStride];
+
+    for (unsigned step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + bottom + top;
+        output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
+
+        index += planeStride;
+        bottom = center;
+        center = top;
+        if (step + 1 < steps) {
+            top = input[index + planeStride];
         }
     }
-    
-    // Copy boundary values
-    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
-        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
-            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
-                if (x == 0 || x == nx-1 || y == 0 || y == ny-1 || z == 0 || z == nz-1) {
-                    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
-                    output[idx] = input[idx];
-                }
-            }
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageSweepPlane(
+        Real sharedPlane[kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2],
+        const Real* __restrict__ input, const size_t index,
+        const unsigned x, const unsigned y,
+        const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const bool active) {
+    if (!active) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;
+    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;
+    sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 1] = input[index];
+    if (tx == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+    }
+    if (tx == kSweepX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 1][tx + 2] = input[index + 1];
+    }
+    if (ty == 0) {
+        sharedPlane[0][tx + 1] = input[index - nx];
+    }
+    if (ty == kSweepY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
+        sharedPlane[ty + 2][tx + 1] = input[index + nx];
+    }
+}
+
+// Sweep a short Z segment while retaining the vertical neighbors in registers.
+// The current XY plane is staged in shared memory, so each grid value is fetched
+// once per tile rather than separately by all of its X/Y neighbors.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kSweepX * kSweepY, 4)
+void stencilSweep(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                  const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                  const size_t planeStride) {
+    __shared__ Real planes[2][kSweepY + 2][kSweepX + 2];
+
+    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kSweepX + threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kSweepY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned firstZ = blockIdx.z * kSweepChunk + 1;
+    const unsigned remaining = nz - 1 - firstZ;
+    const unsigned steps = remaining < kSweepChunk ? remaining : kSweepChunk;
+    const bool active = x < nx - 1 && y < ny - 1;
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(firstZ) * planeStride
+                 + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
+
+    Real bottom = 0.0;
+    Real center = 0.0;
+    Real top = 0.0;
+    if (active) {
+        bottom = input[index - planeStride];
+        center = input[index];
+        top = input[index + planeStride];
+    }
+    stageSweepPlane(planes[0], input, index, x, y, nx, ny, active);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned currentPlane = 0;
+    for (unsigned step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        const unsigned nextPlane = currentPlane ^ 1U;
+        if (step + 1 < steps) {
+            stageSweepPlane(planes[nextPlane], input, index + planeStride,
+                            x, y, nx, ny, active);
+        }
+
+        if (active) {
+            const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x + 1;
+            const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y + 1;
+            const Real sum = center + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx - 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty][tx + 1]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty - 1][tx]
+                           + planes[currentPlane][ty + 1][tx]
+                           + bottom + top;
+            output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        index += planeStride;
+        bottom = center;
+        center = top;
+        if (active && step + 1 < steps) {
+            top = input[index + planeStride];
         }
+        currentPlane = nextPlane;
     }
 }

+bool checkedGridSize(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,

+__device__ __forceinline__ Real averageOfSeven(const Real sum) {

stencil3d.cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

using Real = double;

namespace {

[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
                              const char* file, const int line) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d for %s: %s\n", file, line,
                 expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
    do {                                                                         \
        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                       \
        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                   \
            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);      \
        }                                                                        \
    } while (false)

constexpr unsigned kBlockX = 32;
constexpr unsigned kBlockY = 4;
constexpr unsigned kBlockZ = 2;
constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ;

__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* __restrict__ grid1,
                                Real* __restrict__ grid2,
                                const size_t elementCount) {
    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (index < elementCount) {
        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
        grid1[index] = value;
        grid2[index] = value;
    }
}

// For this benchmark all operands are finite and nonnegative. A reciprocal
// estimate followed by an FMA residual correction produces the same correctly
// rounded result as division by 7, without invoking CUDA's general FP64 divider.
__device__ __forceinline__ Real averageOfSeven(const Real sum) {
    constexpr Real reciprocal = 0x1.2492492492492p-3;
    const Real estimate = sum * reciprocal;
    const Real remainder = __fma_rn(-7.0, estimate, sum);
    return __fma_rn(remainder, reciprocal, estimate);
}

// Boundaries are invariant. Both buffers are initialized identically, allowing
// every iteration to update only the interior and avoid a full boundary-copy
// pass. A warp spans consecutive X coordinates, so all seven reads and the
// write are coalesced; adjacent warps provide cache reuse in Y and Z.
__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 2)
void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
                      Real* __restrict__ output,
                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
                      const size_t planeStride) {
    const unsigned x = blockIdx.x * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;

    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {
        return;
    }

    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(z) * planeStride
                       + static_cast<size_t>(y) * nx + x;
    const Real sum = input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
                   + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
                   + input[index - planeStride] + input[index + planeStride];
    output[index] = averageOfSeven(sum);
}

bool checkedGridSize(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
                     size_t& elementCount, size_t& byteCount) {
    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {
        return false;
    }
    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
    if (plane > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nz) {
        return false;
    }
    elementCount = plane * nz;
    if (elementCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(Real)) {
        return false;
    }
    byteCount = elementCount * sizeof(Real);
    return true;
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid) {
    for (const Real value : grid) {
        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
            return false;
        }
    }

    const auto bounds = std::minmax_element(grid.begin(), grid.end());
    std::printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", *bounds.first, *bounds.second);
    if (*bounds.second > 1e6 || *bounds.first < -1e6) {
        std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* programName) {
    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);
    std::printf("Options:\n");
    std::printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\n");
    std::printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    std::printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\n");
    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    size_t nx = 128;
    size_t ny = 0;
    size_t nz = 0;
    int iterations = 10;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;

    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-x") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            nx = std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-y") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            ny = std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-z") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            nz = std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            iterations = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;
    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;
    if (nx < 3 || ny < 3 || nz < 3
        || nx > std::numeric_limits<unsigned>::max()
        || ny > std::numeric_limits<unsigned>::max()
        || nz > std::numeric_limits<unsigned>::max()
        || iterations < 0) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid dimensions must be in [3, 2^32-1] and iterations must be nonnegative.\n");
        return 1;
    }

    size_t elementCount = 0;
    size_t byteCount = 0;
    if (!checkedGridSize(nx, ny, nz, elementCount, byteCount)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid size is too large.\n");
        return 1;
    }

    std::printf("3D Stencil Benchmark\n");
    std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
    std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", iterations);
    std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    std::printf("Initializing grid...\n");

    Real* deviceGrid1 = nullptr;
    Real* deviceGrid2 = nullptr;
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceGrid1, byteCount));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceGrid2, byteCount));

    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));

    constexpr unsigned kInitializeThreads = 256;
    const size_t initializeBlocks = (elementCount + kInitializeThreads - 1) / kInitializeThreads;
    if (initializeBlocks > std::numeric_limits<unsigned>::max()) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid requires too many CUDA blocks.\n");
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid2));
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid1));
        return 1;
    }
    initializeGrids<<<static_cast<unsigned>(initializeBlocks), kInitializeThreads, 0, stream>>>(
        deviceGrid1, deviceGrid2, elementCount);
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));

    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, kBlockZ);
    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX),
                      static_cast<unsigned>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY),
                      static_cast<unsigned>((nz - 2 + kBlockZ - 1) / kBlockZ));
    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;

    // Capture the complete iteration chain once. A single graph submission
    // removes per-iteration CPU launch latency, especially on smaller grids.
    cudaGraph_t graph = nullptr;
    cudaGraphExec_t graphExecution = nullptr;
    Real* input = deviceGrid1;
    Real* output = deviceGrid2;
    Real* output = deviceGrid2;
    if (iterations > 0) {
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamBeginCapture(stream, cudaStreamCaptureModeGlobal));
        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
            stencilIteration<<<blocks, block, 0, stream>>>(
                input, output, static_cast<unsigned>(nx), static_cast<unsigned>(ny),
                static_cast<unsigned>(nz), planeStride);
            std::swap(input, output);
        }
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph));
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphInstantiate(&graphExecution, graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0));
    }

    cudaEvent_t startEvent = nullptr;
    cudaEvent_t stopEvent = nullptr;
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&startEvent));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&stopEvent));

    std::printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(startEvent, stream));
    if (iterations > 0) {
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphLaunch(graphExecution, stream));
    }
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(stopEvent, stream));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(stopEvent));

    float elapsedMilliseconds = 0.0f;
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventElapsedTime(&elapsedMilliseconds, startEvent, stopEvent));
    std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", elapsedMilliseconds);

    const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(nx - 2)
                             * static_cast<double>(ny - 2)
                             * static_cast<double>(nz - 2) * iterations;
    const double mcups = elapsedMilliseconds > 0.0f
        ? cellUpdates / (static_cast<double>(elapsedMilliseconds) * 1.0e3)
        : 0.0;
    std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);

    std::vector<Real> finalGrid;
    if (printResults || validate) {
        finalGrid.resize(elementCount);
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(finalGrid.data(), input, byteCount, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    }

    if (printResults) {
        print_results(finalGrid, "Grid");
    }

    bool valid = true;
    if (validate) {
        std::printf("Validating result...\n");
        valid = validateResult(finalGrid);
        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
    }

    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(stopEvent));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(startEvent));
    if (graphExecution != nullptr) CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphExecDestroy(graphExecution));
    if (graph != nullptr) CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphDestroy(graph));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid2));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid1));
    return valid ? 0 : 1;
}

+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid size is too large.\n");
+        return 1;
+    }
+
+    std::printf("3D Stencil Benchmark\n");
+    std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
+    std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", iterations);
+    std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
+    std::printf("Initializing grid...\n");
+
+    Real* deviceGrid1 = nullptr;
+    Real* deviceGrid2 = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceGrid1, byteCount));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&deviceGrid2, byteCount));
+
+    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+
+    constexpr unsigned kInitializeThreads = 256;
+    const size_t initializeBlocks = (elementCount + kInitializeThreads - 1) / kInitializeThreads;
+    if (initializeBlocks > std::numeric_limits<unsigned>::max()) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid requires too many CUDA blocks.\n");
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid2));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid1));
+        return 1;
+    }
+    initializeGrids<<<static_cast<unsigned>(initializeBlocks), kInitializeThreads, 0, stream>>>(
+        deviceGrid1, deviceGrid2, elementCount);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
+
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, kBlockZ);
+    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX),
+                      static_cast<unsigned>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY),
+                      static_cast<unsigned>((nz - 2 + kBlockZ - 1) / kBlockZ));
+    const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;
+
+    // Capture the complete iteration chain once. A single graph submission
+    // removes per-iteration CPU launch latency, especially on smaller grids.
+    cudaGraph_t graph = nullptr;
+    cudaGraphExec_t graphExecution = nullptr;
+    Real* input = deviceGrid1;
+    Real* output = deviceGrid2;
+    if (iterations > 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamBeginCapture(stream, cudaStreamCaptureModeGlobal));
+        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
+            stencilIteration<<<blocks, block, 0, stream>>>(
+                input, output, static_cast<unsigned>(nx), static_cast<unsigned>(ny),
+                static_cast<unsigned>(nz), planeStride);
+            std::swap(input, output);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphInstantiate(&graphExecution, graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0));
+    }
+
+    cudaEvent_t startEvent = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t stopEvent = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&startEvent));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&stopEvent));
+
+    std::printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(startEvent, stream));
+    if (iterations > 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphLaunch(graphExecution, stream));
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(stopEvent, stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(stopEvent));
+
+    float elapsedMilliseconds = 0.0f;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventElapsedTime(&elapsedMilliseconds, startEvent, stopEvent));
+    std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", elapsedMilliseconds);
+
+    const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(nx - 2)
+                             * static_cast<double>(ny - 2)
+                             * static_cast<double>(nz - 2) * iterations;
+    const double mcups = elapsedMilliseconds > 0.0f
+        ? cellUpdates / (static_cast<double>(elapsedMilliseconds) * 1.0e3)
+        : 0.0;
+    std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
+
+    std::vector<Real> finalGrid;
+    if (printResults || validate) {
+        finalGrid.resize(elementCount);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(finalGrid.data(), input, byteCount, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+
+    if (printResults) {
+        print_results(finalGrid, "Grid");
+    }
+
+    bool valid = true;
+    if (validate) {
+        std::printf("Validating result...\n");
+        valid = validateResult(finalGrid);
+        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(stopEvent));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(startEvent));
+    if (graphExecution != nullptr) CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphExecDestroy(graphExecution));
+    if (graph != nullptr) CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphDestroy(graph));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid2));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid1));
+    return valid ? 0 : 1;
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ Real averageOfSeven(const Real sum) {
+    constexpr Real reciprocal = 0x1.2492492492492p-3;
+    const Real estimate = sum * reciprocal;

+// For this benchmark all operands are finite and nonnegative. A reciprocal
+// estimate followed by an FMA residual correction produces the same correctly
+// rounded result as division by 7, without invoking CUDA's general FP64 divider.
+__device__ __forceinline__ Real averageOfSeven(const Real sum) {
+    constexpr Real reciprocal = 0x1.2492492492492p-3;
+    const Real estimate = sum * reciprocal;
+    const Real remainder = __fma_rn(-7.0, estimate, sum);
+    return __fma_rn(remainder, reciprocal, estimate);
+}
+
+// Boundaries are invariant. Both buffers are initialized identically, allowing
+// every iteration to update only the interior and avoid a full boundary-copy
+// pass. A warp spans consecutive X coordinates, so all seven reads and the
+// write are coalesced; adjacent warps provide cache reuse in Y and Z.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock, 2)
+void stencilIteration(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                      Real* __restrict__ output,
+                      const unsigned nx, const unsigned ny, const unsigned nz,
+                      const size_t planeStride) {

+    const unsigned y = blockIdx.y * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const unsigned z = blockIdx.z * kBlockZ + threadIdx.z + 1;

+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || z >= nz - 1) {

+                   + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                   + input[index - planeStride] + input[index + planeStride];

+bool checkedGridSize(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                     size_t& elementCount, size_t& byteCount) {
+    if (nx > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / ny) {

+    }

+    if (elementCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(Real)) {
+        return false;
+    }

+    return true;

+__device__ __forceinline__ Real averageOfSeven(const Real sum) {
+    constexpr Real reciprocal = 0x1.2492492492492p-3;
+    const Real estimate = sum * reciprocal;
+    const Real remainder = __fma_rn(-7.0, estimate, sum);
+    return __fma_rn(remainder, reciprocal, estimate);
